attributes.description:
OpenResponses is a native iPhone client for the OpenAI Responses API built for people who want full control, clear observability, and modern tool support. Bring your own API key, stream responses in real time, inspect every request, and use the latest OpenAI models in a fast SwiftUI interface.

Model Lineup

- GPT-5.4, GPT-5.3, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.1, GPT-5, and GPT-5-mini
- o3 and o4-mini reasoning models with configurable effort
- GPT-4.1 family, GPT-4o, and gpt-image-1

What Makes It Different

- Real-time streaming with activity feed, token usage, and Assistant Thinking traces
- Request Inspector for payloads, tool calls, and raw Responses API details
- Explore Demo so new users can try the interface before adding an API key
- Prompt Library, advanced model controls, exports, and local conversation history
- Message quick actions plus direct camera, photo, file, and document attachments

Tools Included

- Web Search with live sources
- Code Interpreter for Python, analysis, charts, and artifacts
- Image Generation with gpt-image-1
- File Search and vector store workflows
- Computer Use preview with explicit approval steps
- Direct Notion integration and Apple system tools when you choose to enable them

Built for Apple

- Calendar, Contacts, and Reminders tools when you enable them
- Permissions shown only when related features are used
- SwiftUI experience with Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, and VoiceOver support

Privacy

- Your OpenAI API key is stored in the iOS Keychain
- Before the first live AI request, the app shows an in-app OpenAI data sharing notice and requires explicit approval
- No required account
- Conversation history stays on device unless you choose to send or export it

AI output can be inaccurate or outdated. Verify important information before acting.

Requirements

- iOS 17.0 or later
- Your own OpenAI API key with active billing
attributes.promotionalText: Bridges multiple OpenAI endpoints natively. Toggle between stateless Responses, legacy Assistants threads, low-latency Realtime Voice, Batch, and Fine-Tuning.
attributes.whatsNew:
This major update introduces full integration for stateless Responses, legacy Assistants migration compatibility, low-latency Voice chat, and advanced developer operations, alongside critical security enhancements and Swift 6 concurrency compliance.

1. Unified OpenAI Endpoints & Developer Operations
• Legacy Assistants API Compatibility: Maintain support for stateful Assistant threads and runs to facilitate migrations ahead of the August 2026 sunset.
• Realtime Voice WebSockets: Connect directly to bi-directional WebSockets for conversational speech, featuring active Voice Activity Detection (VAD) and user barge-in handling.
• Developer Operations: In-app Batch Jobs and Fine-Tuning managers to monitor asynchronous JSONL datasets and train custom models.

2. Security & Privacy Hardening
• Sensitive Data Redaction: Automatically redacts plaintext API keys, Bearer tokens, cookies, and sensitive HTTP headers from local console logs.
• Environment Protection: Excludes local environment configurations (e.g., test.env) from production bundles to prevent credential leaks.

3. Swift 6 Concurrency Migration
• Strict Concurrency Compliance: Resolved thread-safety compilation errors and compiler warnings under strict Swift 6 mode across Keychain, Contacts, NotionProvider, and WKWebView coordinators.

4. Performance & Core Engine Optimizations
• Memory & Parsing Efficiency: Reduced heap allocations during Server-Sent Events (SSE) parsing and optimized string concatenation pipelines.
• Notion Integration Speedups: Accelerated database metadata fetching and schema lookups.
• Asynchronous Networking: Parallelized concurrent file uploads and optimized sequential image download queuing to prevent UI main-thread blockages.
• Layout Adaptability: Refactored status bar items, toggles, and badges to prevent truncation and text wrapping on smaller devices.

5. Robustness & Test Coverage
• Graceful Automation Recovery: Added state self-healing to completely reset streaming states if a local web automation tool fails or loses connection.
• Test Suite Expansion: Added extensive unit tests covering URL detection edge cases, ISO8601 date parsing, and function calling JSON formats.
